extends Node
var p
var last_probe_idle := -1
func _ready() -> void:
	p = get_meta("viento_project")
	set_process(false)
	set_physics_process(false)
	call_deferred("_run")
func _probe(label: String) -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	last_probe_idle = Engine.get_process_frames()
	print("VIENTO_EXECUTION_FRAME_PROBE:" + JSON.stringify({"label": label, "clock": {"idleFrame": Engine.get_process_frames(), "physicsFrame": Engine.get_physics_frames()}, "revision": host.state_revision}))
func _finish() -> void:
	p.host.get_ref().finish_project()
func _run() -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	host.set_process(false)
	var q
	for actor in host.current.actors:
		if actor["instanceId"] == "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbb2":
			q = actor["node"].get_node("behavior_62626262_6262_4262_8262_000000000019").get_meta("viento_project")
	p.select_animation_clip("59595959-5959-4595-8595-000000000002")
	p.play_animation()
	q.select_animation_clip("59595959-5959-4595-8595-000000000001")
	q.play_animation()
	host.flush_requests()
	host.elapsed_seconds += 0.5
	host.total_seconds += 0.5
	host.current.project_step(0.5)
	host.flush_requests()
	p.write_state("counter", 1)
	_probe("mixed-complete")
	call_deferred("_finish")
